download.button: Download vanilla assets (about 45 MB, from Mojang's official servers)
download.note: This connects to Mojang's official servers (piston-meta.mojang.com, piston-data.mojang.com) and downloads the latest Minecraft Java Edition release client jar into this app's data folder on your computer. Only its textures are read. No personal information is sent and nothing updates automatically; the app only goes online when you click this button.
